name: Detect text
description: Finds text in an image and returns OCR regions, polygons, confidence scores, and optionally recognized text. Detection does not erase or regroup text; downstream tools may consume its output.

fields.name: ocr_engine
fields.description: Selects the OCR implementation used to detect text. PaddleOCR is the installed default and returns oriented text polygons, recognized text, and confidence scores. Tesseract and Keras-OCR are optional adapters and are selectable only when their dependencies are installed.

options.name: PaddleOCR
options.description: Uses PaddleOCR for text detection and recognition, including quadrilateral text polygons.

options.name: Tesseract
options.description: Uses Tesseract OCR when installed; its word or line boxes are normalized to the common detection result format.

options.name: Keras-OCR
options.description: Uses Keras-OCR when installed; its detected word polygons and recognized strings are normalized to the common detection result format.

fields.name: processing
fields.description: Controls whether the OCR engine only locates text geometry or also recognizes the characters inside each detected region. Recognition is required for HTML export and text modification; detection-only mode is sufficient when geometry alone will drive erasure.

options.name: Detect + recognize
options.description: Returns text polygons together with recognized strings and confidence scores.

options.name: Detect only
options.description: Returns text polygons without running character recognition, reducing work when the text content is not needed.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Defines which image area is sent to OCR. Full page scans the entire image. Selected region restricts OCR to a user-drawn area and maps returned polygons back into full-image coordinates.

options.name: Full page
options.description: Runs OCR across the complete image.

options.name: Selected region
options.description: Runs OCR only inside the active selection.

fields.name: overlay
fields.description: Controls how detection results are drawn in the editor. This changes only the preview overlay and does not change OCR processing or its results.

options.name: Polygons + text
options.description: Draws each detected polygon and its recognized string.

options.name: Polygons
options.description: Draws detected polygons without recognized strings.

options.name: Text
options.description: Shows recognized strings without polygon outlines.

options.name: Hidden
options.description: Keeps detection results available to tools but hides them on the canvas.

fields.name: advanced_thresholds
fields.description: Exposes engine-specific detection thresholds such as PaddleOCR box confidence, box threshold, and polygon expansion ratio. These settings tune which candidate regions PaddleOCR accepts; they do not perform paragraph grouping.

action.name: Run OCR
action.description: Runs the selected OCR engine with the configured processing mode and scope, stores normalized detection results, and refreshes the chosen overlay.
